title: Mozambique calculator readiness research — Batch 31
executive_summary: Added official MAAP 2025/26 campaign plan and flood monitoring snapshot, recorded INE's 2025 agriculture-indicators publication, and added Mozambique's 11 provincial-level selector entries. Existing 2024 crop production totals remain national output-only. Mozambique is not calculator-ready because matched crop-by-province harvested area/yield, verified producer-level prices, farmer-paid input costs and enterprise budgets are incomplete.

sources.use: 2025/26 campaign plans: 7.8m ha planned, 3.4m tonnes cereals, 0.93m tonnes legumes, 10.2m tonnes roots/tubers, 0.4m tonnes oilseeds and 2.1m tonnes horticulture; January flood snapshot.
Official 2025 agriculture and food indicators publication identified; PDF extraction still required.
2020–2024 national crop production totals; no crop-by-province yield admitted.
Weekly producer, wholesale and retail price collection methodology; actual recent bulletins/data extract still required.
Provincial cereal reference-price portal; exact market and transaction levels must be verified.
Final Agricultural and Livestock Census announcement; headline holdings/area/herd only pending full Excel extraction.

provincial_coverage.note: Includes Maputo City separately from Maputo Province; district-level mapping remains a separate validation task.

safeguards: Campaign plans are not represented as final actual production.
Flood impacts are retained by affected province, not applied as a uniform national yield penalty.
National production totals are not converted into yields without matching crop-specific harvested area.
ICM/SIMA market prices are not labelled farm-gate without transaction-level confirmation.
Aggregate beans and local chicken statistics are not mapped to cowpea or commercial poultry enterprise profiles.
Original 10 active calculator countries remain unchanged; Mozambique stays directory-only.
remaining_work: Download and extract the INE 2025 Basic Indicators of Agriculture and Food PDF; reconcile it with the 2024 Statistical Yearbook production series.
Extract crop-specific cultivated and harvested area, production and yield tables from the 2023 IAI report and final CAP 2023/2024 Excel tables at provincial and district level.
Check the IAI 2023 exclusion of nine insecure Cabo Delgado districts; document coverage gaps and do not imply full provincial survey coverage.
Separate paddy rice from milled rice and distinguish rainfed lowland, irrigated and upland systems.
Separate feijão nhemba (cowpea), feijão manteiga, feijão bóer and other beans; do not use aggregate beans output for the Beans (Cowpea) calculator profile.
Obtain original dated SIMA weekly Quente-Quente bulletins and ICM provincial cereal quotations; preserve producer, wholesale and retail transaction levels separately.
Obtain dated producer prices for horticultural commodities by province, grade and unit.
Obtain farmer-paid seed, fertilizer, pesticide, labour, machinery, irrigation, pumping, land preparation, transport and post-harvest costs by province and production system.
Obtain species-specific livestock output, liveweight, sale price, feed, veterinary, mortality and housing cost data; distinguish local chickens from commercial broilers and layers.
Resolve unusual annual administrative production values against IAI and CAP survey outputs before using them as yield assumptions.
Do not activate country-specific calculator profiles until matched crop area/production definitions, regional yields, prices and enterprise budgets have been independently checked.
